label: Footer disclaimer — intro
body_html: All products offered by Peptide Tech LLC through peptidetech.cc are supplied exclusively as research chemicals intended for laboratory research use only. They are not intended for human consumption or for medical, veterinary, agricultural, diagnostic, therapeutic, or any other non-research purposes. By purchasing or using any product, you affirm you are a qualified professional acquiring research chemicals solely for lawful laboratory research, and you are at least 21 years of age.

label: Research Use Only (RUO) labeling
body_html:
Research Use Only (RUO) labeling

The RUO label states intended laboratory research use only. It does not itself create a regulatory exemption, and product status depends on objective intended use and all applicable federal, state, local, and institutional law.

label: Not a compounding pharmacy or outsourcing facility
body_html:
Not a compounding pharmacy or outsourcing facility

These products fall outside Sections 503A and 503B of the FD&C Act. Peptide Tech LLC is not a 503A compounding pharmacy or a 503B outsourcing facility, and products are not compounded medications.

label: Not drugs, supplements, or food
body_html:
Not drugs, supplements, or food

Products are not drugs, dietary supplements (DSHEA), food, food additives, cosmetics, or medical devices. All site information is educational only, has not been evaluated by the FDA, and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

label: Controlled substances & doping
body_html:
Controlled substances & doping

Products are not intended to be controlled substances under the CSA (21 U.S.C. § 801 et seq.). The purchaser is responsible for compliance with the CSA, DEA requirements, and any anti-doping rules. Resale or distribution for non-research use is prohibited.

label: Jurisdiction, import & export
body_html:
Jurisdiction, import & export

Certain compounds are restricted in some states and countries. Restricted jurisdictions may be declined or flagged at checkout. The purchaser is responsible for compliance with all applicable laws, including import/export regulations.
